ImageDescription.value:
Pula, is the seventh-largest city in Croatia, situated at the southern tip of the Istrian peninsula in western Croatia. It is known for its multitude of ancient Roman buildings, the most famous of which is the Pula Arena, one of the best preserved Roman amphitheatres.

The Scotch Mist Gallery contains many photographs of historic buildings, monuments and memorials of Poland and beyond.
